facts.fact: The Ministry of Health said World Bank experts proposed an integrated digital platform for managing hospitals, centres and health posts plus centralised health data to improve collection and exchange, and the minister confirmed implementation of the proposed solutions would begin, with a joint technical committee to follow development.
facts.system: Integrated digital platform for health institutions and services with centralised health data

systems.system: Integrated digital platform for health institutions and services with centralised health data
systems.owner: Ministry of Health with World Bank

note: Date taken from the document's published date (2026-03-09, the day of the meeting); the statement is of proposals accepted for implementation, not a system in service.
